deviations: Phases A, B and C are read off the server log and the client consoles after teardown (the self-report lines print once, at OnServerStarted and OnGameStart, before any probe can run); their verdicts are graded there.

Phase F reads the script item's Calories through the harness's item.script getter route; the mod's own sentinel reads a fresh instance's Food.getCalories (#2680), so the two routes are not the same read.
The driver runs the layout lint itself (pzt.harness.lint_paths, the gate pzt run applies) because it builds the session through make_server rather than pzt run.
